faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about Banana Pro and Nano Banana 2.

items.question: What makes Nano Banana 2 better than previous models?
items.answer: Nano Banana 2 features a major leap in reasoning, world knowledge, and generation speed, allowing for more complex prompt following and faster results.

items.question: Can I use Banana Pro for commercial design projects?
items.answer: Yes, Banana Pro is designed for professionals with precision text placement, aspect ratio controls, and high-resolution output suitable for commercial use.

items.question: How does the 'Impossible Selfies' feature work?
items.answer: By uploading a reference photo, Banana Pro can seamlessly place you in any environment or outfit while maintaining your unique features.

items.question: Is the content generated safe and ethical?
items.answer: We prioritize safety with advanced filters to prevent harmful content and use digital watermarking (SynthID) for transparent attribution.

items.question: Does it support multiple languages?
items.answer: Yes, Banana Pro understands and processes prompts in dozens of languages, including English and Chinese.
